config.swap_retract_length_hint: Toolhead → Y-splitter distance. Empty = default 900. 0 = legacy full retract.
config.fa_load_disable: Disable feed-assist / ACE feed during load
config.mode_change_pending: Klipper restart required to apply mode change
config.mode_locked_msg: Unload all toolheads first to switch to or from Normal mode. Still loaded: {heads}.
config.update_intro: Pulls the latest multiACE release and installs it.
config.update_apply_msg: Downloads and installs {to} (currently: {from}). Klipper restarts afterwards. Make sure no print is running first.
config.debug_explain: Updates only survive the next reboot once persistent updates are enabled. To enable, run the command below over SSH and reboot.
config.debug_apply_locked_tip: Enable persistent updates first, otherwise this install gets wiped on the next reboot.
config.debug_disable_msg: Removes /oem/.debug. The next reboot will wipe /oem/overlay/upper - installed updates revert to whatever is baked into the firmware image. Use this to roll back a bad install.
config.debug_reboot_prompt: Debug mode is now ENABLED. Reboot once so the overlay-wipe is skipped from now on.
config.debug_reboot_msg: Sends /machine/reboot to Moonraker. Any running job is aborted.
config.head_mode_hint: Head mode: each head is ACE-driven by default. Toggle individual heads to "Feeder" on the dashboard to hand them to their stock side feeder.
config.confirm_commands_label: Ask before load/unload in the web UI
config.confirm_commands_hint: A confirmation dialog before any action that moves filament (load, unload, load all, unload all). Web UI only - gcode, display and print are never gated. Applies immediately (no Save needed) and is stored on the printer, so it holds on every device.
config.pickup_cleaning_label: Wipe the nozzle after tool pickups that have no cleaning move
config.pickup_cleaning_hint: After a same-colour tool pickup with no swap/flush, a short nozzle wipe at the discard position removes the parked head's ooze thread (real swaps and background arrivals already wipe). Costs a discard excursion per pickup; applies to the next preflighted print.
config.airprint_detection_label: Pause the print when a lane stops flowing (chew/clog protection)
config.airprint_detection_hint: Watches every load's coil measurement against the lane's own baseline (per lane AND per head) and monitors back-pressure live while printing (airlog chew detector). Two suspicious readings pause the print resumably - before air is printed. Warnings are always logged; this switch only arms the pauses. Persisted; overrides the [ace] resistance_pause config default.
config.tipform_intro: Replaces ONLY the pull moves of the filament tip forming - discard position, heating, ooze scrape-off and nozzle cleaning stay stock. 'stock' keeps the firmware behaviour; 'custom' uses the tables below (key = filament type as declared on the slot; 'default' applies to everything without its own table, 'soft' to flexible filament). Tables are validated before saving - an invalid table is rejected here instead of halting Klipper. Changes apply after a Klipper restart.
config.tipform_stock_hint: Insert the firmware's stock pull as a starting point
config.tipform_err_name: Every table needs a name (the filament type, e.g. petg).
config.tipform_restart_pending: The saved configuration differs from what Klipper is running - restart Klipper to apply.
config.tipform_syntax: Tokens: <mm>@<feedrate> (extruder move, negative = retract, mm/min) - pause:<ms> - temp:<C> (set, no wait) - waittemp:<C> (set + wait, both directions; below 175 no further moves allowed - Klipper min_extrude_temp; slow in background swaps) - fan:<0-255> (inline only) - unloadtemp:<C> (unload/tip-form temp for this material/vendor, default 250; may be a table's only content = stock pull at that temp) - loadtemp:<C> (load/seat/verify temp, default = filament-DB load temp; the stuck-tip retry still escalates to the DB temp). A table must end with a net retract. The background swap uses the same tables.
config.tipform_unsupported: This multiACE build has no tip-forming module - update multiACE first.
config.quad_replenish_label: Auto-reload from a backup slot on runout
config.quad_replenish_hint: When a spool runs out and no twin head can take over, the head is reloaded from a slot with the same declared identity (type + color) and the print resumes automatically. Head mode: the other slots of the head's ACE; multi: the same slot on another ACE.
config.stock_first_label: Switch heads first (before draining the lane)
config.stock_first_hint: Off (default): the printing head works through its own ACE slots first, then the next head takes over - reaches every spool and keeps the sliced head layout, but each spool change costs a reload (~90s). On: stock switches to another loaded head first - instant, but it rewrites the tool mapping for the rest of the print, leaves the slots of heads that already emptied unused, and cannot act at all across different nozzle sizes.
config.fluidd_panel_add: Add as a camera in Fluidd
config.fluidd_panel_added: Added - open Fluidd and show the camera card.
config.fluidd_panel_hint: Registers the compact panel as an "HTTP Page" camera, so it appears on the Fluidd dashboard. An entry of the same name is left alone, so your own adjustments survive a second click.
config.spoolman_url_hint: e.g. http://192.168.1.50:7912 - leave empty to switch Spoolman off
config.spoolman_hint: With a URL set, Spoolman is the source of truth: a pull takes over material, vendor, colour and the remaining weight, and consumption is reported back as length (Spoolman applies its own density). Only spools carrying a Spoolman id take part - locally added ones stay local. Applies immediately, no Save needed.
config.acefw_confirm_msg:
⚠️ AT YOUR OWN RISK! ACE {ace} will be flashed with version {version}.

An interrupted flash (power loss, USB unplugged, Klipper restart) usually leaves the unit dead only until a flash completes — but it can also brick it PERMANENTLY; bricking cannot be ruled out. Never during a print. Do not touch power or cables while flashing.

Neither multiACE nor Anycubic take any responsibility.
config.acefw_force_hint: Flash even if this version is already installed (test/repair). The tested-versions byte gate still applies.
config.acefw_intro: multiACE ships no firmware and links to none. You need the Anycubic update package for the selected target version and its password — alternatively, perform the update through an Anycubic printer. Flash at your own risk.
config.purge_matrix_label: Use the preflight’s per-colour-pair purge lengths
config.purge_matrix_hint: The preflight sizes each swap’s purge from the slicer’s flush matrix, so a cheap colour pair purges less than an expensive one. Off makes the engine ignore those stamps and purge the fixed length again - also on files that already carry them. Applies live, no restart.
config.spool_mode_need_conn: Needs a live Spoolman connection (checkmark next to the URL)
config.spool_mode_need_agent: SpoolLink is not active on this printer (paxx: enable the Spoolman integration)
config.spool_mode_hint: Local: table and counting on the printer. Spoolman: multiACE sets identities and reports usage to Spoolman. SpoolLink (paxx): SpoolLink sets and counts – multiACE only binds and displays; hand-fed heads are not counted there. Switching local ↔ Spoolman drops all spool bindings.

dialog.snapshot_warnings_hint: Apply anyway? The web UI will follow the actual loaded filament after the load.

spools.hint: Local spool table - a slot references a spool, so a spool taken out and put back keeps its remaining weight. The weight is an ESTIMATE from extruded length (purge included), not a scale: correct it against a real one now and then.
spools.label: Label
spools.weight_dlg_msg: Remaining weight in grams (scale). Identity and usage are managed by Spoolman.

spools.new_from_slot: New spool from this slot (adopts material, colour and the RFID SKU)
spools.new_weight_hint: Start weight in grams for the new spool (optional - net, without the core)
spools.assign_prompt: Assign to which slot? Format: ACE/Slot, e.g. 1/3
spools.delete_msg: Remove "{name}" from the table? A slot binding is cleared with it. The filament itself is not touched.
spools.empty: No spools yet - add one above.
spools.write_back: Save the changed values ({fields}) to spool "{spool}" as well?
spools.sku_taken_msg: Tag code {sku} already belongs to spool #{id} ({spool}). A code may belong to only ONE spool, otherwise the tag cannot say which one is meant. Pick a code of your own for the new spool:
spools.sku_taken_hint: A suggestion. Write this code onto the new spool’s tag and it will be recognised automatically again when inserted - otherwise you have to assign it by hand. Leave empty for no code.
spools.sku_still_taken: That code already belongs to spool #{id}.

spools.search_ph: Search the list – name, material, colour, assignment …
spools.add_pending: Add still running – click ignored (printer busy)

msg.pause_swap_slot_empty: [multiACE] Slot empty for Head {head} (ACE {ace} / Slot {slot}) - load filament, then RESUME
msg.pause_swap_slot_empty_post: [multiACE] Slot empty for Head {head} (ACE {ace} / Slot {slot}) after unload - load filament, then RESUME
msg.pause_bg_pick_no_flow: [multiACE] Pick check on Head {head}: no filament flow detected after the background load - check the head/nozzle, reload if needed (display/web), then RESUME
msg.pause_swap_unload_jam: [multiACE] Unload jam on Head {head} - unload ACE{ua}/Slot{us}, load ACE{la}/Slot{ls}, then RESUME
msg.pause_swap_load_slip: [multiACE] Load slip on Head {head} (ACE {ace} / Slot {slot}) - unload, reload, then RESUME
msg.pause_swap_load_no_transport: [multiACE] Load failed on Head {head} (ACE {ace} / Slot {slot}): filament never reached the toolhead (NO TRANSPORT) - check spool / bowden / ACE path, then unload, reload, RESUME
msg.pause_swap_load_no_flow: [multiACE] Load failed on Head {head} (ACE {ace} / Slot {slot}): filament arrived but the nozzle does not extrude (NO FLOW) - check the nozzle for a clog; unload+reload alone will not fix a clog. Then RESUME
msg.pause_swap_load_ace_slip: [multiACE] Load failed on Head {head} (ACE {ace} / Slot {slot}): the ACE motor turned but the filament did not move (SLIP AT THE ACE) - check the spool seat and the path into the ACE, push the filament at the inlet by hand if needed, then reload and RESUME
msg.resistance_warn: [multiACE] WARNING: rising back-pressure on ACE {ace} / Slot {slot} (Head {head}): coil delta {delta} vs baseline {baseline} (suspect #{strikes}) - check spool / bowden / nozzle of this lane
msg.resistance_pause: [multiACE] Sustained back-pressure on Head {head}: the lane resists feeding (chew/clog building up, extruder may click) - check spool / bowden / nozzle, then RESUME
msg.airlog_chew_pause: [multiACE] Head {head} is printing against heavy resistance (coil delta {delta}, sustained) - filament is grinding instead of flowing (under-extrusion in progress). Check spool / bowden / nozzle, then RESUME
msg.pause_feed_load_jam: [multiACE] Load jam on Head {head}{loc} - reload via display/web, then RESUME
msg.pause_feed_error: [multiACE] Feed error on Head {head}{loc} - check filament, then RESUME
msg.pause_manual_feed_error: [multiACE] Manual feed error on Head {head}{loc} - check filament, then retry
msg.pause_runout: [multiACE] Runout on Head {head}{loc} - reload filament, then RESUME
msg.pause_ace_comms_lost: [multiACE] ACE {ace} comms lost (Head {head}) - check USB/power, then RESUME
msg.head_manual_loaded: [multiACE] Head {head} still has filament loaded - unload it first to change manual mode
msg.feed_manual_skip: [multiACE] Head {head} is manual - load/unload by hand, ACE feed skipped
msg.unload_head_already_empty: [multiACE] Head {head} is already empty - nothing to unload
msg.no_devices_after_wait: Found {count} of {expected} ACE devices after waiting; continuing - connect more by reconnecting them.
msg.feed_assist_disarmed: Feed assist disarmed on ACE {ace} slot {slot}
msg.feed_assist_armed: Feed assist armed on ACE {ace} slot {slot}
msg.usb_unstable: [multiACE] USB unstable, expected {expected} ACEs, found {count} - ACE inactive, Klipper continues. multiACE keeps scanning and restarts automatically once the ACEs are back (only while idle).
msg.all_expected_found: [multiACE] All {expected} expected ACE device(s) found, canonical mapping locked
msg.no_ace_serial_configured: [multiACE] No ACE devices found and no serial configured - ACE inactive, Klipper continues
msg.open_ace_failed_attempts: [multiACE] Failed to open ACE {ace} at startup after {attempts} attempts
msg.not_all_aces_opened: [multiACE] Not all ACEs opened at startup - continuing with partial set
msg.print_start_head_needs_unavailable: [multiACE] WARNING: Head {head} needs ACE {ace} but only {count} ACE(s) available!
msg.print_start_head_needs_disconnected: [multiACE] WARNING: Head {head} needs ACE {ace} which is not connected!
msg.ghost_heads: [multiACE] GHOST HEAD(S): {heads} have filament at the toolhead sensor but no head_source mapping. ACE_SWAP_HEAD will be refused for these heads. Recover: ACEC__Unload_All then ACEB__Load_N for each affected head, then restart the print.
msg.head_source_inconsistent: [multiACE] PRINT ABORTED: inconsistent slot mapping ({detail}). The saved head/slot configuration is corrupt (a head is mapped to a slot that is not its own, or two heads share one slot). Recover: ACEC__Unload_All, then run ACE_CLEAR_HEADS, then restart the print.
msg.print_start_fa_enabled: [multiACE] Print start: feed_assist enabled on ACE {ace} slot {slot} (head {head})
msg.cascade_detected: [multiACE] CASCADE detected: {count} ACEs failed in <1.5s (total cascades this session: {total})
msg.serial_write_recovered: [multiACE] ACE {ace} serial write recovered after reconnect
msg.fa_failed_final: [multiACE] FA start_feed_assist FAILED after {attempts} attempt(s) on ACE {ace} slot {slot}: code={code} msg={msg} - this lane will NOT be fed; check that filament is loaded into the ACE slot
msg.fa_failed_pause: [multiACE] Feed-assist could not be armed on ACE {ace} slot {slot} ({attempts} attempts) - head {head} would print without feed (ACE 2 cannot freewheel). Print PAUSED; fix the ACE (jam/busy/filament) and RESUME to retry
msg.load_refused_auto_mode: [multiACE] Load head {head}: the stock feed channel REFUSED the load - per-port automatic feeding (touchscreen AutoLoad) for this head's port is OFF, so the load was silently skipped and NO filament was fed. Enable AutoLoad for this port on the touchscreen, then retry
msg.load_not_finished: [multiACE] Load head {head}: the feed channel did not run the load (state={state}) - filament did NOT reach the head; aborting instead of continuing dry
msg.bg_pick_no_flow_pause: [multiACE] Head {head}: the background load could not be verified - NO flow at the nozzle even after a re-grip. Print PAUSED before printing dry; check nozzle/filament, purge manually, then RESUME
msg.bg_pick_absent_pause: [multiACE] Head {head}: marked loaded by the background swap but the toolhead sensor reads NO filament. Print PAUSED; load the head manually, then RESUME
msg.ace_stuck_powercycle: [multiACE] ACE {ace} stuck in status={status} after {attempts} reconnect attempts - aborting operation. Power-cycle the ACE.
msg.ace_stuck_pause: [multiACE] ACE {ace} is not responding (stuck in status={status}). Power-cycle the ACE (off/on), wait for it to reconnect, then RESUME.
msg.ace_unresponsive_pause: [multiACE] ACE {ace} unresponsive - reconnect failed. Check USB/power, power-cycle the ACE, then RESUME.
msg.ace_wait_busy_feeding: [multiACE] ACE {ace} busy with a slot feeding/rollback (e.g. an inserted spool's pre-load) - waiting for it to finish ({attempt}/{max}), not a hang
msg.switch_in_progress: [multiACE] ACE switch already in progress, please wait
msg.ace_already_active_loading: [multiACE] ACE {ace} already active, loading available filaments...
msg.switch_extruder_full_unload: [multiACE] Extruder {head}: filament in head, full unload
msg.switch_extruder_skip_unload: [multiACE] Extruder {head}: not in head, skipping unload
msg.switch_skip_unload_no_replacement: [multiACE] Head {head}: ACE {ace} / Slot {slot} is empty - keeping the filament instead of unloading for nothing
msg.switch_extruder_already_loaded: [multiACE] Extruder {head}: filament already in head, skipping
msg.switch_extruder_no_filament: [multiACE] Extruder {head}: no filament in ACE, skipping
msg.ace_out_of_range_for_head: [multiACE] ACE {ace} out of range for head {head}
msg.load_head_already_loaded: [multiACE] Head {head} already has filament loaded. Unload first.
msg.load_head_inferred_only_ace: [multiACE] Head {head} already loaded, mapped to the only connected ACE / Slot {slot}
msg.load_head_no_source_recorded: [multiACE] Head {head} has filament but no head_source recorded. With {count} ACEs connected the source cannot be inferred safely. Run Unload All to clear all heads, then load fresh.
msg.load_slot_no_filament: [multiACE] ACE {ace} / Slot {slot} has no filament! Aborting load.
msg.unload_sensor_no_filament: [multiACE] Note: Sensor on head {head} not detecting filament (may be stationary)
msg.unload_head_no_mapping: [multiACE] Unloading head {head} (no ACE mapping, using active ACE)...
msg.unload_filament_still_detected: [multiACE] Warning: Filament still detected in head {head} after unload!
msg.test_cancelled: [multiACE] TEST CANCELLED by user - stopping after step {step}
msg.test_cancel_requested: [multiACE] TEST cancel requested - stopping after current step
msg.swap_refused_fa_load_disable: [multiACE] SWAP refused: ACE {ace} is in fa_load_disable. This ACE expects manual filament feed - swap not supported. Load head {head} manually instead.
msg.swap_complete: [multiACE] === Swap complete: Head {head} now on ACE {ace} / Slot {slot} ===
msg.usb_stats_summary: [multiACE] USB stats (uptime {uptime:.1f}min): errno5={errno5} (recovered={recovered}, lost={lost}), cascades={cascades}, connects={connects}, disconnects={disconnects}
msg.switching_ace_for_retract: [multiACE] Switching to ACE {ace} for head {head} retract...
msg.ace_failed_after_retries: [multiACE] Failed to connect to ACE {ace} after 5 retries, skipping head {head}
msg.no_filament_in_any_head: [multiACE] No filament detected in any head
msg.switched_to_mode: [multiACE] Switched to {mode} mode. No reboot needed.
msg.state_debug_status: [multiACE] State debug is {state} (gates state audit, telemetry, wiggle)
msg.fa_test_running: [ACE_FA_TEST] ACE={ace} scenario={scenario} slots={slots} delay={delay:.2f}s repeats={repeats} steps={steps} inter={inter:.2f}s retries={retries} retry_delay={retry_delay:.2f}s - running, watch klippy.log
msg.unload_gate_empty: [multiACE] Head {head}: ACE {ace} / Slot {slot} reports EMPTY while the toolhead still holds filament - it likely ran out or broke ABOVE the ACE gate. The machine cannot retract it (the tail is out of the ACE gears): heat the head, open the bowden coupling at the toolhead and pull the filament out by hand, then reload the slot.
msg.quad_replenish_start: [multiACE] Quad Replenish: Head {head} ran out - reloading from ACE {ace} / Slot {slot} (same declared identity), print resumes automatically
msg.quad_replenish_done: [multiACE] Quad Replenish: Head {head} reloaded from ACE {ace} / Slot {slot} - resuming print
msg.quad_replenish_too_fast: [multiACE] Head {head}: runout again after only {seconds}s - auto-reload stopped for this head (a spool lasts minutes; this looks mechanical). Check the filament path, then reload and RESUME.
msg.quad_replenish_failed: [multiACE] Quad Replenish FAILED on Head {head} (backup ACE {ace} / Slot {slot}): reload did not complete. Check the backup spool, then reload manually (display or web 'Reload') and RESUME
msg.spool_tag_bound: [multiACE] Spool #{id} ({spool}) bound to ACE {ace} / Slot {slot} by its RFID tag
msg.spool_tag_unbound: [multiACE] ACE {ace} / Slot {slot}: tag reads '{sku}', which matches no spool table entry - released the old binding to #{id} ({spool}). Adopt/create the new spool to track its consumption.
msg.spool_tag_material_mismatch: [multiACE] Spool #{id} (ACE {ace} / Slot {slot}) says {table}, but its RFID tag reads {tag} - following the tag. Correct the material in the spool table.
msg.spool_tag_duplicate: [multiACE] ACE {ace} / Slot {slot}: this tag belongs to spool #{id} ({spool}), which sits in ACE {oace} / Slot {oslot} - so this is a SECOND spool with the same factory code. Not assigned. Give it its own entry with '+' (its consumption is not tracked until you do).
msg.spool_tag_ambiguous: [multiACE] ACE {ace} / Slot {slot}: tag code {sku} exists more than once in the spool table, so it cannot say WHICH of them this is - not assigned automatically. Pick the right entry in the slot dialog; that choice then sticks.
msg.spool_sku_suffixed: [multiACE] Spool #{id}: the tag code was already taken, so it was stored as {sku}. Note: its tag still reads the ORIGINAL code, so this spool cannot be recognised automatically - assign it by hand, or write it an own tag.
msg.spool_tag_color_mismatch: [multiACE] Spool #{id} (ACE {ace} / Slot {slot}) is {table} in the spool table, but its RFID tag reads {tag} - following the tag. If these are two different spools sharing a code, give this one its own entry.
msg.spool_bound_elsewhere: [multiACE] Spool #{id} ({spool}) sits in ACE {ace} / Slot {slot} and that slot is occupied - take it out there first, then it can be assigned here.
msg.auto_dry_config_follower: [multiACE] Auto-dry ACE {ace} (follower): {state}, master {master}, {temp} °C, runs on {add} min
msg.spool_sku_taken: [multiACE] Tag code {sku} already belongs to spool #{id}. A code may belong to only ONE spool - pick another one (an existing assignment is never overwritten).
msg.head_feeder_loaded: [multiACE] Head {head} still has filament loaded - unload it first to switch between feeder and ACE
msg.head_ace_loaded: [multiACE] Head {head} still has filament loaded - unload it first to change which ACE feeds it
msg.spool_head_not_feeder: [multiACE] Head {head} is ACE-driven - its spool follows the slot it loads from. Bind the spool to the ACE slot instead; a head binding is for feeder/manual heads.
